mapper.select: SELECT condition_id AS conditionId, user_id AS userId, title, rental_type AS rentalType, dest_address AS destAddress, commute_type AS commuteType, max_commute_time AS maxCommuteTime, max_transfer_count AS maxTransferCount, min_area AS minArea, max_deposit AS maxDeposit, max_rent AS maxRent, created_at AS createdAt FROM user_conditions WHERE condition_id = #{conditionId}

SELECT condition_id AS conditionId, user_id AS userId, title, rental_type AS rentalType, dest_address AS destAddress, commute_type AS commuteType, max_commute_time AS maxCommuteTime, max_transfer_count AS maxTransferCount, min_area AS minArea, max_deposit AS maxDeposit, max_rent AS maxRent, created_at AS createdAt FROM user_conditions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_saved = TRUE ORDER BY created_at DESC
